mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand that depresses corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contractions (INDPRO < 100), declining manufacturing output reduces corporate capacity utilization and profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly real GDP growth rate (GDPC1) reflects expanding economic activity that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 grows, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it triggers central bank tightening concerns and erodes real returns, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in nonfarm payroll growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), higher interest rates increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
